method: True-label fixed-eight residual using the mean of5 class-balanced Bayesian-bootstrap training weight draws, with validation-selected shrinkage
training_weights: Generate5 Exponential(1) draws with SeedSequence(seed,fold,1017); multiply each by training class balancing; normalize each sum n_train; average weights
normalization: Current training feature mean and population SD floor0.01; project after normalization
selection: Validation balanced accuracy, minimum BCE, smaller residual strength, stronger lambda
projection: Orthonormal QR projection of a fixed Gaussian matrix; generated without labels or outcomes
